item.title: Iinari Cosplayer Kanami-chan no Shuuchi Satsueikai
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Huurainodan
  • 発売日: 2014-10-18
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: いいなりコスプレイヤーかなみちゃんの羞恥撮影会
  • 英語名: Iinari Cosplayer Kanami-chan no Shuuchi Satsueikai

别名

  • Obedient Cosplayer Kanami

あらすじ

The girl who showed up at the event venue was rumored to be the kind of cosplayer who’d do any lewd pose—a girl who’d say yes to anything.

Kanami, a girl with a passion for cosplay, had always enjoyed her hobby in her own way. But one ordinary afternoon after school, she fell into a trap set by a man and was raped.
